actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free-riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is low (<30% of endowment), so conserve rule limits contribution to ~30% of wallet (~0.73). Average contribution last round is above the low threshold, so no conditional boost. Round 15 requires a norm broadcast. No affordable punishment available.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action for round 15. Wallet 2.44, initial 100 so <30% -> conserve 30% of wallet = 0.732. Check average contribution last round (14): contributions sum? total_pool 9.7468 includes all contributions before multiplier? Actually total_pool is sum contributions then multiplied? unclear. But average contribution per agent = total_pool / multiplier? Not needed. Likely average low? round14 contributions: Resident1 1, Resident2 1, Resident3 0, Resident4 0, Resident5 1.3868, Resident6 6.36. Sum = 9.7468. Average = 9.7468/6 ≈1.624. That's >30% of endowment (30). So conditional cooperation not triggered (needs avg <30% of endowment i.e., <30). So just baseline 80%? But conserve rule says if wallet <30% initial, reduce to 30% of wallet. So contribute 0.732.

Also broadcast every 5 rounds: rounds 5,10,15... So round15 needs broadcast norm.

No punish because need two consecutive low contributions <10% endowment (10 units) by any agent. Check any agent contributed <10? All contributions are <=6.36, all <10, but threshold is 10% of endowment =10 units. So anyone contributed less than 10 for two consecutive rounds? Likely many have, but need monitor: Resident3 contributed 0 in round14, also 0 in round13, that's two consecutive <10, so we can punish Resident3 with amount 10 (cost 3). Do we have enough wallet? Wallet 2.44, punishment cost 0.3 per unit, amount10 costs 3, we cannot afford. So cannot punish.

Thus actions: contribute 0.73 (maybe round to two decimals). broadcast message.

Return JSON.
